description.value: Tickleberry's Downtown is the year-round outpost of the beloved Okanagan Falls ice cream institution, serving made-in-house ice cream cones, Bright Jenny Coffee from Kelowna, and house-made treats at a full-service coffee shop. The location also houses an in-house Fudge Factory where visitors can watch confections being made, plus a gift shop stocked with local B.C. gourmet food and artisan goods. It's a natural stop for cyclists travelling the Okanagan corridor looking for a sweet treat and a rest.

address.value: 202 Main St, Penticton, BC V2A 5B2, Canada
